capabilities: Insert 1-12 column blocks via command palette or hotkey
Write columns blocks by hand with +++ separators
Edit columns inline in Live Preview as real editors
Add, remove and navigate columns with hover controls and keys
Style columns via settings, cssclasses or CSS snippets
extras: Requires Obsidian 1.13 or later. Without the plugin installed, the columns block remains a plain code block, so notes stay readable; columns stack vertically on screens under 600px wide.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to write side-by-side column layouts that stay editable in Live Preview.

relations.evidence: Alternatively, install the BRAT plugin and add Jakimcikas/obsidian-column-flow.

summary: Column blocks you insert as plain Markdown and edit directly in Live Preview, shown as rendered cards otherwise.
